Several AI models were reportedly released in early-to-mid October 2026, though the sources are mostly release trackers rather than official announcements, and they disagree in places.

**Most recent launches:**
- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017:** One tracker lists this as the newest release, dated October 17, 2026. The newest is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 from DeepSeek, released October 17, 2026.

- **Muse Wonder (Meta):** Listed for October 12, 2026. 12 Oct Muse Wonder Meta
- **Nemotron 3.5 models (NVIDIA):** Another tracker lists Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for October 15. This week: Muse Spark Open, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on 15 Oct, Muse Wonder on 12 Oct, plus 1 more.

- **Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic):** Listed for October 7. Oct 7 Claude Haiku 5.5
- **Mistral Large 4:** Released as a public preview on October 6. Oct 6 Mistral Large 4 (public preview)
- **Microsoft speech models:** Microsoft introduced MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for live speech transcription and two speech-generation models, MAI-Voice-2.1 and MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash.

This week's releases were dominated by DeepSeek, Meta, Google, and Reflection AI, with several smaller launches alongside them. Most of the details below come from aggregator trackers and news roundups, so check the primary announcements before relying on specific figures.

**Notable launches (Oct 13–18, 2026)**

- **DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 (Oct 17):** DeepSeek released an update of its AI model this weekend that it says is faster and leaner. DeepSeek posted V4.1-Flash-1017 to Hugging Face under MIT license, and it is a 552B-parameter sparse MoE with a 1M-token context. The release also opens its Search and Fetch APIs to all developers.
- **Meta Muse Spark Open (Oct 15):** One tracker says Meta's new open-weight model for coding and agent tasks, which Meta calls the most capable US open-weight model so far. Meta's top Muse Wonder models stay closed.
- **Google Gemini 4 Argon, general availability (Oct 13):** Google's newest frontier model is now broadly available, after launching only to vetted cyber defenders. Developers can reach it through the paid Gemini API, AI Studio, and Google Cloud.
- **Reflection AI Beam (Oct 16):** Reflection AI released Beam on Oct 16 under Apache 2.0 — a 501B-total / 23B-active MoE for coding, agents, science and math.
- **xAI Grok Voice 3.0 (Oct 14):** Listed by LLM Gateway as released by xAI on October 14, 2026.
- **StepFun Step 5 Preview (reported Oct 18):** StepFun released open weights for Step 5 Preview, a 600-billion parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts model intended for long-horizon agentic work.

**Other smaller releases**

- Palo Alto startup Elorian, backed by Nvidia and Jeff Dean on a $55M seed at ~$3B, released Glimpse Oct 16: a visual reasoning model.
- Microsoft AI's new MAI-Base-2 is a 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts foundation model (the source gives no date).
- Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, an image model rather than an LLM.

**Caveats**

- The sources disagree on some dates. One tracker lists Muse Wonder on Oct 12, just before this window, while another centers on Muse Spark Open on Oct 15.
- Several of these are aggregator or tracker listings, not official announcements, so verify against the labs' own blogs or model cards.

Links: [{"title":"Google expands Gemini 4 Argon access across API and subscriber products","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-releases-gemini-4-argon-for-scientific-computing-644a49ff"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon llega, dónde usarlo y cuánto cuesta","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/es/news/23459/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-es"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon is available today, where to use it and what it costs","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/23457/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-en"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon chega ao app Gemini, onde usar e qual o preço","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/pt/news/23478/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-pt"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon now available: long decode, limits, pricing","url":"https://braindetox.kr/en/posts/gemini_4_argon_general_availability_2026.html"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon debiutuje, gdzie z niego korzystać i ile kosztuje","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/pl/news/23481/gemini-4-argon-debiutuje-gdzie-korzystac-cena"},{"title":"Google Opens Gemini 4 Argon to Gemini App Subscribers","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-opens-gemini-4-argon-to-gemini-app-subscribers-6313cd7e"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon: API price, access, and context","url":"https://toolhalla.ai/blog/gemini-4-argon-api-price-context-2026"},{"title":"gemini argon launch access facts review draft","url":"https://www.callmissed.com/blog/gemini-argon-launch-access-facts-review-draft"}]

Yes. Gemini 4 Argon reached general availability in the Gemini API on October 13, 2026, after a restricted preview. Coverage of the API details is mostly consistent, but sources disagree on which plans and surfaces get access.

**Timeline:** Google first showed Argon to a limited group of cybersecurity partners on September 30, so the October update widened access rather than introducing the model. Google said on Oct. 13 that Gemini 4 Argon is now available to developers and enterprises through the Gemini API, AI Studio and the Gemini platform. The Gemini API changelog lists it as generally available under the model ID gemini-4-argon, "Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon) generally available (GA)."

**API details:** The model ID is gemini-4-argon. Its documented combined input-output context limit is 1,048,576 tokens. Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, 2026, after which standard prices rise to $4 and $20 per million tokens (per Google listed introductory API pricing ... with a 95% cached-input discount. It said standard prices would then be $4 and $20 per million tokens.).

**Access conflicts:** This is where the sources diverge.
- Google's GA post, as quoted by Toolhalla, names developers and enterprises using the API in AI Studio and the Gemini platform, plus Antigravity for AI Ultra subscribers and the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search for Ultra and Pro subscribers. ([8-15](8-15))
- The developer pricing page reportedly says Argon is not available on the Free tier or on the Google AI Pro plan, so API use appears to require a paid API plan. ([5-11](5-11))
- Other coverage says that AI Studio and the Antigravity desktop app and CLI require an AI Ultra subscription. ([7-3](7-3))
- One Spanish-language report notes that Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes did not yet include an entry for Argon, even though the Gemini API changelog did. ([3-16](3-16))

Because of these conflicts, I'd check the official Gemini API changelog and pricing page directly before relying on a specific plan or surface. Some of these sources are secondary blogs, and the Google announcement itself wasn't retrieved directly.

Web search results for query: "Meta Muse Spark Open open-weight model release"

Links: [{"title":"meta muse spark open","url":"https://thenewstack.io/meta-muse-spark-open/"},{"title":"Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B model with open weights","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/24330/meta-muse-spark-open-816b-open-weights"},{"title":"Meta unveils new 'open' AI model to rival Chinese competition","url":"https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/tech/meta-open-ai-model-rival-chinese-competition"},{"title":"thenewstack.io","url":"https://thenewstack.io/?p=22840587"},{"title":"meta open ai model rival chinese competition","url":"https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/tech/meta-open-ai-model-rival-chinese-competition?amp=1"},{"title":"Meta Releases Muse Spark To Reenter AI Race","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/meta-releases-muse-spark-to-reenter-ai-race-273982bf"},{"title":"www.theregister.com","url":"https://www.theregister.com/a/5294093"},{"title":"Muse Spark Open","url":"https://www.vals.ai/models/meta_muse-spark-open"},{"title":"meta muse spark 1 2 explained","url":"https://orcarouter.ai/blog/meta-muse-spark-1-2-explained"}]

Meta released Muse Spark Open on October 15, 2026, as an open-weight model. The sources agree on the basics but differ on how open it really is.

- **Release and access:** Meta published the weights on Hugging Face. Muse Spark Open is Meta's open weights model, available to download on Hugging Face since October 15, 2026. Weights are also available through Amazon SageMaker AI, Google Cloud Model Garden, Hugging Face, and Microsoft's Foundry Model Catalog.
- **Size and context:** One report puts the model at 816 billion total parameters (42 billion active for each token), reads up to 1 million tokens of context.
- **Positioning:** Meta says it competes with Chinese open-weight leaders. Alibaba's Qwen, Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 and Z.ai's GLM models have been considered open-weight frontrunners globally, but Meta claims its new open model now competes on a similar level. Alexandr Wang called it "the most capable US open-weight model to date". Independent results are more modest: Vals AI ranks it #38 of 49 models on the Vals Index with 46.61%.
- **Intended use:** "Built for coding and agentic work", Muse Spark Open "excels at long-horizon tasks, complex software engineering, and multi-step reasoning", Meta said in a blog post. Meta also says it is "optimised" to run on Apple's advanced M5 Ultra chips.
- **License caveat:** The model ships under the Muse Model License. Meta describes it as having "limited commercial terms, which allow many developers to use the model for free." One analysis says the weights are open but the license doesn't tell the same story. A second report notes commercial limits and a 20 million dollar threshold. Check the license text before commercial use.
- **Background:** Muse Spark launched in April as a closed model. Unlike Meta's prior Llama releases, Muse Spark is initially closed and deployed inside Meta products. In July, Zuckerberg had said an open-weights version would come "soon".

Sources conflict mainly on how "open" the release is. The weights are downloadable, but the license restricts commercial use. The parameter count and threshold come from one secondary outlet, so verify them against Meta's model card.
